headline: Australia Jobless Rate Hits Five-Year High as Employment Falls
summary: Australia's unemployment rate reached a five-year high after employment fell for a second consecutive month, driven primarily by declines in part-time roles.
why: Employment data is a critical indicator for the Reserve Bank of Australia when setting monetary policy and determining interest rate trajectories.

impacts.name: Australian Dollar
impacts.why: Softer employment figures and rising unemployment increase market expectations for monetary policy easing, weighing on the currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weak employment data and a rising jobless rate prompted markets to ramp up rate-cut bets for 2027, putting downward pressure on the Australian dollar.
